items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: Not at that time, I don't know. I forgot the fella, but I mean, still, I remember Cucu was playing with him, but.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. Who else is in the, who's the, uh, coronetist in the Olympia band? Do you remember? Cucu. Cucu, with a cow. Oh yeah, a cow.

Not at that time, I don't know. I forgot the fella, but I mean, still, I remember Cucu was playing with him, but. The half of it before Cucu? Oh yeah. I think one time, even Frederick Heppard was in the Olympia, way back. Was there a young Olympia?

I don't know, it seems like. They had two Olympia. I think so. They had the old Olympia and they had the young Olympia. I believe Ricard Alexis told us once that he started out in the young Olympia or something. That's right.
